description: HTTP User-Agent request header, matched with a regular expression anywhere in the value (use ^ and $ to anchor). Signatures are tried in order and the first match wins, so specific patterns come before general ones. Browsers freeze the OS token (Windows NT 10.0, Mac OS X 10_15_7, Android 10; K), so those map to coarse labels on purpose.

signatures.label: windows-nt10
examples: Microsoft-CryptoAPI/10.0
signatures.notes: Certificate revocation and AIA fetches made by Windows itself, so not affected by browser UA freezing.

signatures.label: windows-legacy
examples: Microsoft-CryptoAPI/6.1

signatures.label: windows-nt10
examples: Windows-Update-Agent/10.0.10011.16384 Client-Protocol/2.71
Microsoft-Delivery-Optimization/10.0
signatures.notes: Windows Update and Delivery Optimization on Windows 10, 11 and Server 2016+.

signatures.label: windows
examples: Microsoft NCSI

signatures.label: android
examples: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 10; K) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/131.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36
signatures.notes: Chrome's reduced User-Agent always says Android 10 with model K, so the version is not known.

signatures.label: android
examples: Dalvik/2.1.0 (Linux; U; Android 13; Pixel 7 Build/TQ3A.230901.001)
Mozilla/5.0 (Android 14; Mobile; rv:133.0) Gecko/133.0 Firefox/133.0
signatures.notes: Also matches Dalvik (Android apps), which reports the real version.

signatures.label: ios

match.pattern: \((?:iPhone|iPad|iPod)(?: touch)?;.*? OS (?P<version>\d+(?:_\d+)*) like Mac OS X

examples: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 17_6_1 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/17.6 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1
Mozilla/5.0 (iPad; CPU OS 16_7 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/16.6 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1
signatures.notes: iPadOS in desktop mode sends a Mac User-Agent and will match ua-macos-frozen instead.

signatures.label: apple
examples: Weather/1 CFNetwork/1494.0.7 Darwin/23.4.0
signatures.notes: Native apps on macOS and iOS. The Darwin version maps to an OS release but is shared by macOS and iOS.

signatures.label: apple

signatures.notes: Browsers send Windows NT 10.0 on both Windows 10 and 11 (and on Server 2016+), so this cannot tell them apart.
